description: Immediate children of a node, cheaper than figma_get_nodes for browsing. Default limit 100, with truncated and next for paging. Compact results include x/y. Composite instance-sublayer parent ids resolve.

compact.description: Minimal data (id, name, type, x, y, parentId, childCount); false for full serialization.

limit.description: Maximum number of children to return

name: figma_get_children
